h1.en: Transformer illustrates the note on Electric 40 vs Electric 30 Concrete Pump
h1.zh: 「变压器」用来说明电动40和电动30混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 30 lists 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动30标出 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 60 m / 180 m、13骨料 20 m / 60 m、骨料 ≤ 3 cm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer. The image subject is Transformer. Electric 30 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Electric 30 lists 30 kW. Fine-stone pumping (H / V): Electric 40 lists 120 m / 360 m. Electric 30 lists 60 m / 180 m. Electric 40 lists entries that Electric 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer。画面内容是Transformer。电动30和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。理论输送量：电动40标出 21 m³/h；电动30标出 12–15 m³/h。13骨料输送（水平/垂直）：电动40标出 40 m / 120 m；电动30标出 20 m / 60 m。细石数对从 60 m / 180 m 变为 120 m / 360 m，数字仍然只属于写出它的那一页。

body.en: Electric 30 lists 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Theoretical output: Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Electric 30 lists 12–15 m³/h. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V): Electric 40 lists 40 m / 120 m. Electric 30 lists 20 m / 60 m. Electric 30 lists entries that Electric 40 does not: Max. aggregate size ≤ 3 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动30标出 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 60 m / 180 m、13骨料 20 m / 60 m、骨料 ≤ 3 cm。最大出口压力：电动40标出 23 MPa；电动30标出 20 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m, plus Kawasaki 112. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Electric 30 lists 20 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m，以及川崎112。料斗容积：电动40标出 0.4 m³；电动30标出 0.3 m³。电动40有、电动30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Electric 40 does not list a separate maximum-aggregate entry. Hopper capacity: Electric 40 lists 0.4 m³. Electric 30 lists 0.3 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The fine-stone pair grows from 60 m / 180 m to 120 m / 360 m, and it still belongs to the page where it is shown. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动40标出 45 kW；电动30标出 30 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动40标出 120 m / 360 m；电动30标出 60 m / 180 m。电动30有、电动40没有的行：最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same motor power as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Electric 30 lists 30 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 45 kW。电动30标出 30 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same theoretical output as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Electric 30 lists 12–15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 21 m³/h。电动30标出 12–15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 30?
question.zh: 电动40和电动30的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Electric 30 lists 20 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 23 MPa。电动30标出 20 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is hydraulic pump missing on Electric 30?
question.zh: 为什么电动30没有液压泵？

answer.en: The Electric 30 page does not list that label. Electric 40 lists Kawasaki 112. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer.
answer.zh: 电动30这一页没有标出这个标题。电动40标出的是 Kawasaki 112。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer画面里印出的数字。
